text:
Riley Torres: heads-up 1 final scope call for MVP tomorrow. We must pick the cuts: telemetry ingest UI (dashboard) vs model-tuning UI. Both are 'nice-to-have'. BetaCorp is pushing hard for audit-grade logs and a private deployment option.

Lin Wang: quick take: telemetry dashboard is expensive (frontend + backend + retention). Model-tuning UI is riskier from product quality POV but lower infra cost if we ship a simple CLI.

Omar Haddad: infra perspective: private deployment for BetaCorp adds network and KMS work. If we keep private, we should cut the telemetry dashboard and keep the core APIs + logs export to their S3. That meets their audit needs without the full UI.

Bea Laurent: customer success checked with BetaCorp PM. They need: 1) audit logs (mandatory), 2) ability to host in their VPC (soft mandate), 3) model-tuning UI optional. They'll accept V1 delivery of the tuning UI but want SLO on logs now.

Riley Torres: ok so realistic options: A) Keep dashboard & defer private deployment -> pushes launch 2w. B) Cut dashboard, ship private hosting + logs -> keep date. C) Keep dashboard, ship limited hosted + promise private in v1 -> complex.

Lin Wang: eng prefers B. Cutting the dashboard removes heavy retention/storage work and we can add an export S3 sink with signed deliveries. Effort: dashboard ~6 dev-days; S3 sink + docs ~3 dev-days + infra config.

Omar Haddad: risk note: if we do private deployment for BetaCorp, we must disable some background batch jobs and provide a policy doc. Timeline for private: ~10 working days after launch (ops + security review).

Bea Laurent: I'll draft a customer-facing commitment: logs + VPC onboarding checklist within 10 business days. If they sign that, we can pick B and keep the launch.

Riley Torres: required decision by EOD. If we choose B, action items: - Bea: get BetaCorp written ack - Lin: PR for S3 logs exporter + feature flag - Omar: private deployment playbook draft - Riley: update milestone tracker and notify sales ops

deploy-bot: Staged branch feature/s3-logs deployed to staging at 2026-03-23T18:07:02Z :white_check_mark:

Lin Wang: draft flag snippet for rollout:
```
feature_flags:
  s3_logs_export: on
  telemetry_ui: off
  private_vpc_mode: manual
```

Bea Laurent: BetaCorp PM confirmed by DM - they accept logs-to-s3 + VPC onboarding in 10 business days. Posting written ok to their account portal now.

Riley Torres: decision: B chosen. Locking MVP scope. I'll update the milestone tracker and publish a short note to execs. Thanks team.
